matchstick.title: Compute numeric values and discrepancy
matchstick.principle: Before moving any matchstick, calculate the integer values of both sides of the equation and determine the numeric discrepancy that must be corrected.
matchstick.when_to_apply: At the start of solving a matchstick puzzle, to guide which stick moves could balance the equation.
matchstick.example: Moving a stick without first computing the left‑ and right‑hand values, leading to a transformation that doesn't affect the imbalance.

matchstick.title: List possible single‑stick transformations
matchstick.principle: Enumerate every way a single matchstick can be moved, considering all possible source characters and target characters, to generate a complete set of candidate transformations.
matchstick.when_to_apply: After computing the discrepancy, to explore all potential stick moves that could resolve it.
matchstick.example: Considering only moves from operators and ignoring possible moves from numerals, missing the correct transformation.

matchstick.title: Match numeric difference to value change
matchstick.principle: Select a stick move whose effect on the numeric values (increase or decrease) exactly matches the required discrepancy, taking into account how changing operators alters operand contributions.
matchstick.when_to_apply: When evaluating candidate transformations, to filter out moves that cannot produce the needed numeric adjustment.
matchstick.example: Changing '+' to '-' but forgetting that the operand's contribution changes by twice its value, resulting in the wrong total.

matchstick.title: Validate resulting characters
matchstick.principle: After applying a candidate stick relocation, verify that each resulting character is a legal Roman numeral or allowed operator; discard any transformation that leaves an invalid symbol.
matchstick.when_to_apply: Immediately after proposing a stick move, before accepting it as a solution.
matchstick.example: Removing a diagonal from an 'X' and leaving a single diagonal line, which is not a valid numeral.

matchstick.title: Consider intra‑character repositioning
matchstick.principle: Allow a stick to be moved within the same character to change its shape (e.g., reposition a diagonal stick to turn a 'V' into an 'X'), expanding the set of possible transformations.
matchstick.when_to_apply: When enumerating single‑stick transformations, include intra‑character moves as candidates.
matchstick.example: Ignoring the possibility of repositioning a diagonal within a 'V' to form an 'X', thereby missing a valid solution.

matchstick.title: Operator modification via equals
matchstick.principle: Consider taking a horizontal stick from the '=' sign (or adding one) to turn it into a '-' sign, or conversely turning a '-' into '=', ensuring the total number of sticks stays constant.
matchstick.when_to_apply: When the numeric discrepancy suggests that changing the equality operator could help, and a horizontal stick is available to relocate.
matchstick.example: Adding a diagonal to '=', creating '≠', which is prohibited.

matchstick.title: Operator modification via plus
matchstick.principle: Consider moving the vertical stick of a '+' sign to turn it into a '-' sign, or adding a vertical stick to a '-' to create '+', while preserving the stick count.
matchstick.when_to_apply: When the discrepancy can be addressed by flipping the sign of an operand, and a vertical stick is available.
matchstick.example: Turning '+' into '-' but discarding the removed vertical stick instead of using it to adjust a numeral.

matchstick.title: Inter‑character stick relocation
matchstick.principle: When moving a matchstick, allow it to be taken from one character (numeral or operator) and placed onto another, transforming both source and target characters.
matchstick.when_to_apply: During the enumeration of candidate moves, to consider cross‑character transformations.
matchstick.example: Moving a diagonal from 'X' to 'I', resulting in an invalid 'I' with a diagonal and an invalid leftover.

matchstick.title: Operator‑to‑operator stick relocation
matchstick.principle: Consider moving a stick directly from one operator to another operator, simultaneously transforming both operators (e.g., '+' to '-' and '-' to '+').
matchstick.when_to_apply: When the discrepancy suggests that swapping operator types could balance the equation.
matchstick.example: Moving a horizontal from '=' to '+' turning '=' into '-' and '+' into '=', but forgetting that '+' now lacks its vertical stick.

matchstick.title: Operator‑plus to minus plus numeral increment
matchstick.principle: When moving the vertical stick from a '+' sign, turn it into a '-' sign and place the removed stick onto a numeral that can accept a vertical stick (forming an extra 'I'), thereby increasing that numeral's value by 1. This combined change often matches a discrepancy of –2 × operand + 1.
matchstick.when_to_apply: If the equation is off by a value that can be corrected by changing a '+' to '-' (affecting the operand by twice its value) and adding 1 to another numeral.
matchstick.example: Moving the vertical stick from '+' to the numeral 'XII', creating 'XIII' while turning '+' into '-', as in IX = XIII - IV.

matchstick.description: Leaving a character invalid after moving a stick
matchstick.why_it_happens: The model removes a stick from a numeral or operator without checking that the remaining shape still corresponds to a legal Roman numeral or operator.
matchstick.how_to_avoid: After removing a stick, verify that the source character still forms a valid Roman numeral or operator before proceeding.

matchstick.description: Failing to verify numeric equality after transformation
matchstick.why_it_happens: The model focuses on moving sticks but does not recompute the numeric values to ensure the resulting equation balances.
matchstick.how_to_avoid: Always compute the integer values of both sides after applying a candidate transformation and confirm they are equal.

matchstick.description: Dropping or omitting parts of the equation
matchstick.why_it_happens: The model truncates the answer or forgets to include the entire equation, resulting in an incomplete expression.
matchstick.how_to_avoid: Ensure the final answer contains the full transformed equation, preserving the left side, '=', and right side.

matchstick.description: Attempting to change '=' into an invalid operator
matchstick.why_it_happens: The model tries to add a diagonal stick to '=', creating '≠', which is prohibited by the puzzle rules.
matchstick.how_to_avoid: Only modify '=' by removing or adding horizontal sticks to turn it into '-' or keep it as '=', never add diagonal sticks.

matchstick.description: Ignoring the numeric impact of operator sign change
matchstick.why_it_happens: The model moves a stick to change an operator (e.g., '+' to '-') but does not account for how this flips the sign of the operand, affecting the total by twice its value.
matchstick.how_to_avoid: When changing an operator, recalculate the contribution of the affected operand, considering that '+' to '-' changes its effect by -2 × operand value.
